title: comarostaphylis arbutoides subsp. costaricensis
intro: Comarostaphylis arbutoides subsp. costaricensis, commonly known as the Guayabillo plant, is a subspecies of shrub in the family Ericaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine for various purposes. It has been reported to have health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may be attributed to its therapeutic actions of reducing pain and fighting infections. The bioactive constituents of Guayabillo plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
